revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Accept. From the online photograph, I agree with all proposed corrections, except for l. 15, where, as already stated by Graham Claytor, κοινωνικῆς seems to be there.

Vote - AcceptText - The proposed corrections have been checked against the original. All are certainly correct with the exception of Z. 15: κοινωνικῆς → κοινωνικοῖς, where I would retain the ed.pr.'s κοινωνικῆς. I see a y-shaped eta, similar to that of τιμήν (l. 13), although elsewhere in the text the h-shaped eta indeed prevails.
Vote - DEFER - Online image a little blurry. Suggest Verhoogt or Claytor check against original.
